meta.name: backlink-audit
meta.description: Backlink / off-page SEO audit. Works WITHOUT a paid tool by default — it uses the Google Search Console Links report (your top linking sites, most-linked pages, and anchor text) plus any backlink export the user provides (Ahrefs / Semrush / Majestic / DataForSEO CSV). Analyzes referring-domain profile, anchor-text distribution (over-optimized / spammy patterns), most-linked pages vs. money pages (internal-linking opportunity), toxic/spam link signals, and link-building priorities. Use this skill when the user asks about backlinks, link building, off-page SEO, referring domains, anchor text, toxic/spam links, disavow, or their link profile. Trigger on: "backlinks", "backlink audit", "link building", "off- page SEO", "referring domains", "anchor text", "toxic links", "spam links", "disavow file", "who links to me", "link profile", "domain authority". NOTE: rich third-party metrics (DR/DA, full link index) require a paid data source; this skill is explicit about what it can and can't see without one.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析外链和引荐域名，发现链接建设机会
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果做网站SEO需要分析外链质量和发现链接机会
copy.tagline_en: Analyze backlinks and referring domains to find link-building opportunities
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you do website SEO and need to analyze backlink quality and find link opportunities

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能分析网站的反向链接情况。它会查看 Google Search Console 的链接报告，或你提供的 Ahrefs、Semrush 等导出文件，然后给出链接概况、锚文本分布、最常被链接的页面、垃圾链接信号以及链接建设优先级。
howto.when: 当你询问关于反向链接、链接建设、站外 SEO、引用域、锚文本、垃圾链接、拒绝链接或链接概况时触发。

say.text: 帮我审计一下这个网站的反向链接。
say.note: Claude 会要求提供网站地址或导出文件。

say.text: 分析我的锚文本分布，看看有没有过度优化。
say.note: Claude 会检查锚文本中品牌词、精确匹配等比例。

say.text: 找出最常被链接的页面，并建议内链优化。
say.note: Claude 会对比高链接页面与转化页面，提出内链机会。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can analyze a website's backlink profile. It uses Google Search Console Links report or a user-provided export (Ahrefs, Semrush, etc.) to produce a link summary, anchor text distribution, most-linked pages, toxic link signals, and link-building priorities.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about backlinks, link building, off-page SEO, referring domains, anchor text, toxic/spam links, disavow, or link profile.

say_en.text: Audit the backlinks for this site.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for the site URL or an export file.

say_en.text: Analyze my anchor text distribution for over-optimization.
say_en.note: Claude checks branded vs. exact-match vs. generic anchors.

say_en.text: Find my most-linked pages and suggest internal linking opportunities.
say_en.note: Claude compares top-linked pages with money pages.
